defects.summary: The shared Unconfined caveat is rewritten ('a shell is always there, and no flag removes it' becomes 'no setting confines it'), also in capabilityAdmission.ts. This changes the sentence that every codex and other unconfined row shows, which is outside E5.5–E5.6's decisions, and no deviation records it.

After the caveat change, the Unconfined standing's doc comment (line 14) and the seed's header (shared/runtime-capabilities.json line 11) still define unconfined as 'a shell is always there', so the definition and the caveat now disagree.

The status line says 'deviations 50–59, not yet reviewed', but the list runs to 60, and deviation 60 speaks of review fixes R1–R3, a commit 0767f419 and a CH1-code.md that are not in this tree, so the status contradicts the list and the claims cannot be checked.
Both stories' 'Done when' needs the live check and the live rows (J2) recorded in RESULTS §31, but the status says 'implemented' and nothing records that those live checks are still owed.
The extra test TheUnconfinedCaveat_ClaimsNoShell_BecauseAKimiRowHasNone (and its TS twin) asserts that a word is absent from a display sentence, only to pin the unrecorded caveat change.

The Scopes and StandIn helpers are copied into both new classes (they already exist in AKimiConsultationScenarioTests), and ConfinementPlannerTests.KimiOnTheRow copies the kimi entry of Adapters() instead of reusing it.

summary: All twelve scenarios are present and pass, and the build, the format check and the generator check are green. The planner arm, the standings, the flag refusal (Leading and Flags), the seed rows with correct cells, the vectors, Runtimes and the generated table all match the decisions, and the check and row tests prove junction-first disposal through the real code paths. The main weakness is an unrecorded change to the shared Unconfined caveat, which also changes what codex rows show, plus plan bookkeeping that is not quite true (the 50–59 vs 60 numbering, 'not yet reviewed' against review fixes, and the owed live checks not named).
